entities.summary: Curtis Millage is an American professional basketball player for who last played for AZS Koszalin of the Polish Basketball League. He played college basketball for Arizona State. At 6 feet 2 inches (1.88 m) and 195 pounds (88 kg), he usually plays as a point guard, but he also can play as a shooting guard.
